verses.ar: بِسۡمِ اللّٰہِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ ﴿۱﴾
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
Ha Mim.[✛]

verses.ar: وَالۡکِتٰبِ الۡمُبِیۡنِ ۙ﴿ۛ۳﴾
verses.en: By this perspicuous Book.

verses.ar: اِنَّاۤ اَنۡزَلۡنٰہُ فِیۡ لَیۡلَۃٍ مُّبٰرَکَۃٍ اِنَّا کُنَّا مُنۡذِرِیۡنَ ﴿۴﴾
verses.en: Truly, We revealed it in a blessed Night. Truly, We have ever been warning against evil.

verses.ar: فِیۡہَا یُفۡرَقُ کُلُّ اَمۡرٍ حَکِیۡمٍ ۙ﴿۵﴾
verses.en: In it all wise things are decided,

verses.ar: اَمۡرًا مِّنۡ عِنۡدِنَا ؕ اِنَّا کُنَّا مُرۡسِلِیۡنَ ۚ﴿۶﴾
verses.en: By Our own command. Verily, We have ever been sending Messengers,

verses.ar: رَحۡمَۃً مِّنۡ رَّبِّکَ ؕ اِنَّہٗ ہُوَ السَّمِیۡعُ الۡعَلِیۡمُ ۙ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: As a mercy from thy Lord. Verily, He is the All-Hearing, the All-knowing,

verses.ar: رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَیۡنَہُمَا ۘ اِنۡ کُنۡتُمۡ مُّوۡقِنِیۡنَ ﴿۸﴾
verses.en: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if you would only have faith.

verses.ar: لَاۤ اِلٰہَ اِلَّا ہُوَ یُحۡیٖ وَیُمِیۡتُ ؕ رَبُّکُمۡ وَرَبُّ اٰبَآئِکُمُ الۡاَوَّلِیۡنَ ﴿۹﴾
verses.en: There is no God but He. He gives life and He causes death. He is your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers.

verses.ar: بَلۡ ہُمۡ فِیۡ شَکٍّ یَّلۡعَبُوۡنَ ﴿۱۰﴾
verses.en: Yet they play about in doubt.

verses.ar: فَارۡتَقِبۡ یَوۡمَ تَاۡتِی السَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِیۡنٍ ﴿ۙ۱۱﴾
verses.en: But watch thou for the day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke,

verses.ar: یَّغۡشَی النَّاسَ ؕ ہٰذَا عَذَابٌ اَلِیۡمٌ ﴿۱۲﴾
verses.en: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.

verses.ar: رَبَّنَا اکۡشِفۡ عَنَّا الۡعَذَابَ اِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ ﴿۱۳﴾
verses.en: Then will the people cry: ‘Our Lord, remove from us the torment; truly, we are believers.’
w: then will the people cry: Our Lord

verses.ar: اَنّٰی لَہُمُ الذِّکۡرٰی وَقَدۡ جَآءَہُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ مُّبِیۡنٌ ﴿ۙ۱۴﴾
verses.en: How can they benefit by admonition, when there has already come to them a Messenger, explaining things clearly,
w: there has already come to them

verses.ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡا عَنۡہُ وَقَالُوۡا مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجۡنُوۡنٌ ﴿ۘ۱۵﴾
verses.en: And yet they turned away from him and said: ‘He is tutored, a man possessed?’

verses.ar: اِنَّا کَاشِفُوا الۡعَذَابِ قَلِیۡلًا اِنَّکُمۡ عَآئِدُوۡنَ ﴿ۘ۱۶﴾
verses.en: We shall remove the punishment for a little while, but you will certainly revert to disbelief.

verses.ar: یَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ الۡبَطۡشَۃَ الۡکُبۡرٰی ۚ اِنَّا مُنۡتَقِمُوۡنَ ﴿۱۷﴾
verses.en: On the day when We shall seize you with the great seizure, then certainly We will exact retribution.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَہُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَہُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ کَرِیۡمٌ ﴿ۙ۱۸﴾
verses.en: And We tried the people of Pharaoh before them, and there came to them a noble Messenger,

verses.ar: اَنۡ اَدُّوۡۤا اِلَیَّ عِبَادَ اللّٰہِ ؕ اِنِّیۡ لَکُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ اَمِیۡنٌ ﴿ۙ۱۹﴾
verses.en: Saying, ‘Deliver to me the servants of Allah. Truly, I am to you a Messenger, faithful to my trust;

verses.ar: وَّاَنۡ لَّا تَعۡلُوۡا عَلَی اللّٰہِ ۚ اِنِّیۡۤ اٰتِیۡکُمۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِیۡنٍ ﴿ۚ۲۰﴾
verses.en: ‘And exalt not yourselves in defiance of Allah. Surely, I come to you with a clear authority.

verses.ar: وَاِنِّیۡ عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّیۡ وَرَبِّکُمۡ اَنۡ تَرۡجُمُوۡنِ ﴿۫۲۱﴾
verses.en: ‘And I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُوۡا لِیۡ فَاعۡتَزِلُوۡنِ ﴿۲۲﴾
verses.en: ‘And if you believe me not, then keep yourselves away from me.’
w: then keep yourselves away from me

verses.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّہٗۤ اَنَّ ہٰۤؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٌ مُّجۡرِمُوۡنَ ﴿ؓ۲۳﴾
verses.en: Then he prayed unto his Lord, saying, ‘These are indeed a sinful people.’

verses.ar: فَاَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِیۡ لَیۡلًا اِنَّکُمۡ مُّتَّبَعُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۲۴﴾
verses.en: God said, ‘Take My servants away by night; for you will surely be pursued.

verses.ar: وَاتۡرُکِ الۡبَحۡرَ رَہۡوًا ؕ اِنَّہُمۡ جُنۡدٌ مُّغۡرَقُوۡنَ ﴿۲۵﴾
verses.en: ‘And leave thou the sea at a time when it is motionless. Surely, they are a host that are doomed to be drowned.’
w: at a time when it is motionless
that are doomed to be drowned

verses.ar: کَمۡ تَرَکُوۡا مِنۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُیُوۡنٍ ﴿ۙ۲۶﴾
verses.en: How many were the gardens and the springs that they left behind!

verses.ar: وَّزُرُوۡعٍ وَّمَقَامٍ کَرِیۡمٍ ﴿ۙ۲۷﴾
verses.en: And the cornfields and the noble places!

verses.ar: وَّنَعۡمَۃٍ کَانُوۡا فِیۡہَا فٰکِہِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۲۸﴾
verses.en: And the comforts wherein they took delight!

verses.ar: کَذٰلِکَ ۟ وَاَوۡرَثۡنٰہَا قَوۡمًا اٰخَرِیۡنَ ﴿۲۹﴾
verses.en: Thus it was destined to be. And We made another people inherit these things.
w: and we made inherit these things

verses.ar: فَمَا بَکَتۡ عَلَیۡہِمُ السَّمَآءُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ وَمَا کَانُوۡا مُنۡظَرِیۡنَ ﴿٪۳۰﴾
verses.en: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they given a respite.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّیۡنَا بَنِیۡۤ اِسۡرَآءِیۡلَ مِنَ الۡعَذَابِ الۡمُہِیۡنِ ﴿ۙ۳۱﴾
verses.en: And We delivered the children of Israel from the abasing torment

verses.ar: مِنۡ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ؕ اِنَّہٗ کَانَ عَالِیًا مِّنَ الۡمُسۡرِفِیۡنَ ﴿۳۲﴾
verses.en: Inflicted by Pharaoh; he was surely haughty even among the extravagant.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدِ اخۡتَرۡنٰہُمۡ عَلٰی عِلۡمٍ عَلَی الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ ﴿ۚ۳۳﴾
verses.en: And We chose them knowingly above the peoples of their time.

verses.ar: وَاٰتَیۡنٰہُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاٰیٰتِ مَا فِیۡہِ بَلٰٓـؤٌا مُّبِیۡنٌ ﴿۳۴﴾
verses.en: And We gave them some Signs wherein was a clear trial.

verses.ar: اِنَّ ہٰۤؤُلَآءِ لَیَقُوۡلُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۳۵﴾
verses.en: These people do say:

verses.ar: اِنۡ ہِیَ اِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا الۡاُوۡلٰی وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنۡشَرِیۡنَ ﴿۳۶﴾
verses.en: ‘It is but our first and only death, after which there is no life and we shall not be raised again.

verses.ar: فَاۡتُوۡا بِاٰبَآئِنَاۤ اِنۡ کُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِیۡنَ ﴿۳۷﴾
verses.en: ‘So bring back our fathers, if you speak the truth.’

verses.ar: اَہُمۡ خَیۡرٌ اَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعٍ ۙ وَّالَّذِیۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِہِمۡ ؕ اَہۡلَکۡنٰہُمۡ ۫ اِنَّہُمۡ کَانُوۡا مُجۡرِمِیۡنَ ﴿۳۸﴾
verses.en: Are they better or the people of Tubba‘ and those before them? We destroyed them because they were sinful.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَیۡنَہُمَا لٰعِبِیۡنَ ﴿۳۹﴾
verses.en: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in sport.

verses.ar: مَا خَلَقۡنٰہُمَاۤ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّ وَلٰکِنَّ اَکۡثَرَہُمۡ لَا یَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ﴿۴۰﴾
verses.en: We created them not but with the requirements of truth and justice, but most of them understand not.
w: with the requirements of truth and justice

verses.ar: اِنَّ یَوۡمَ الۡفَصۡلِ مِیۡقَاتُہُمۡ اَجۡمَعِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۴۱﴾
verses.en: Verily, the Day of Decision is the appointed time for all of them,
w: is the appointed time of them

verses.ar: یَوۡمَ لَا یُغۡنِیۡ مَوۡلًی عَنۡ مَّوۡلًی شَیۡئًا وَّلَا ہُمۡ یُنۡصَرُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۴۲﴾
verses.en: The Day when a friend shall not avail a friend at all, nor shall they be helped,

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ رَّحِمَ اللّٰہُ ؕ اِنَّہٗ ہُوَ الۡعَزِیۡزُ الرَّحِیۡمُ ﴿٪۴۳﴾
verses.en: Save those to whom Allah shows mercy. Surely, He is the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.ar: اِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّوۡمِ ﴿ۙ۴۴﴾
verses.en: Verily, the tree of Zaqqum

verses.ar: طَعَامُ الۡاَثِیۡمِ ﴿ۖۛۚ۴۵﴾
verses.en: Will be the food of the sinful,

verses.ar: کَالۡمُہۡلِ ۚۛ یَغۡلِیۡ فِی الۡبُطُوۡنِ ﴿ۙ۴۶﴾
verses.en: Like molten copper, it will boil in their bellies,

verses.ar: کَغَلۡیِ الۡحَمِیۡمِ ﴿۴۷﴾
verses.en: Like the boiling of scalding water.

verses.ar: خُذُوۡہُ فَاعۡتِلُوۡہُ اِلٰی سَوَآءِ الۡجَحِیۡمِ ﴿٭ۖ۴۸﴾
verses.en: ‘Seize him and drag him into the midst of the blazing Fire;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّوۡا فَوۡقَ رَاۡسِہٖ مِنۡ عَذَابِ الۡحَمِیۡمِ ﴿ؕ۴۹﴾
verses.en: ‘Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.’

verses.ar: ذُقۡ ۚۙ اِنَّکَ اَنۡتَ الۡعَزِیۡزُ الۡکَرِیۡمُ ﴿۵۰﴾
verses.en: ‘Taste it! Thou didst consider thyself the mighty, the honourable.

verses.ar: اِنَّ ہٰذَا مَا کُنۡتُمۡ بِہٖ تَمۡتَرُوۡنَ ﴿۵۱﴾
verses.en: ‘This indeed is what you did doubt.’

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِیۡنَ فِیۡ مَقَامٍ اَمِیۡنٍ ﴿ۙ۵۲﴾
verses.en: Verily, the righteous will be in a place of security,
And gardens and springs,

verses.ar: یَّلۡبَسُوۡنَ مِنۡ سُنۡدُسٍ وَّاِسۡتَبۡرَقٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِیۡنَ ﴿ۚۙ۵۴﴾
verses.en: Attired in fine silk and heavy brocade, facing one another.

verses.ar: کَذٰلِکَ ۟ وَزَوَّجۡنٰہُمۡ بِحُوۡرٍ عِیۡنٍ ﴿ؕ۵۵﴾
verses.en: Thus will it be. And We shall consort them with fair maidens, having wide, beautiful eyes.

verses.ar: یَدۡعُوۡنَ فِیۡہَا بِکُلِّ فَاکِہَۃٍ اٰمِنِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۵۶﴾
verses.en: They will call therein for every kind of fruit, in peace and security.

verses.ar: لَا یَذُوۡقُوۡنَ فِیۡہَا الۡمَوۡتَ اِلَّا الۡمَوۡتَۃَ الۡاُوۡلٰی ۚ وَوَقٰہُمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِیۡمِ ﴿ۙ۵۷﴾
verses.en: They will not taste death therein, other than the first death. And He will save them from the punishment of the blazing Fire,
w: and He will save them from

verses.ar: فَضۡلًا مِّنۡ رَّبِّکَ ؕ ذٰلِکَ ہُوَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡعَظِیۡمُ ﴿۵۸﴾
verses.en: As an act of grace from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.

verses.ar: فَاِنَّمَا یَسَّرۡنٰہُ بِلِسَانِکَ لَعَلَّہُمۡ یَتَذَکَّرُوۡنَ ﴿۵۹﴾
verses.en: And We have made it (the Qur’an) easy in thy tongue that they may give heed.
w: We have made it (the Qur’an) easy

verses.ar: فَارۡتَقِبۡ اِنَّہُمۡ مُّرۡتَقِبُوۡنَ ﴿٪۶۰﴾
verses.en: So wait thou; they too are waiting.
